journal.heading: Journal
journal.empty: Your story has not yet begun. Roll for your first prompt.
journal.duplicatePrompt: This prompt already exists, you cannot re-add it
journal.narrationForward: The night carries you forward to prompt {page}.
journal.narrationHeld: The past holds you — visit {count} of prompt {page}.
journal.narrationExhausted: Three visits exhausted — you move on to prompt {page}.

memories.heading: Memories
memories.full: Your mind is full. You must forget a memory to make room for more.
memories.noneForgotten: You have forgotten no memories... yet.
memories.starTitle: Cemented forever — this memory no longer takes up a slot and can never be changed or lost.
memories.editLocked: You cannot alter this memory whilst it is being edited.

characters.heading: Characters
characters.editLocked: You cannot change this character whilst it is being edited.
characters.needNameBio: You must provide a name & bio.

skills.heading: Skills
skills.editLocked: You cannot change this skill whilst it is being edited.

resources.heading: Resources
resources.diaryDecayed: The diary has decayed and lost capacity
resources.editLocked: You cannot change this resource whilst it is being edited.
resources.oneDiary: You may only have one active diary.
resources.crossOutFirst: Please cross out existing memories before losing the diary.

load.heading: Load
load.needOneFile: Unable to load file. You must select one file to load.

import.heading: Import Prompts
import.explanation: Paste the Prompts section from your copy of the book as plain text (headers like 1a, 1b, 1c followed by the prompt text), or choose a .txt file. The journal will then show each prompt's text based on the page and visit.
import.packLoaded: A prompt pack is already loaded; importing replaces it.

1a

import.needOneFile: You must select one file to import.
import.nothingFound: No prompts found. Paste the Prompts section of the book as plain text.
import.successWarnings: Imported {count} prompts ({warnings} warning). | Imported {count} prompts ({warnings} warnings).
